plan.count_scope: text causal model, including embeddings, output head, and output adapter; no vision/MTP

protocol.controls: Fresh source load per arm. Shared and local bases use identical large calibration corpus. Same-width local arm explicitly exceeds shared storage. No selection on held-out generations.
protocol.rms_fit: 33 quadratic/linear features of retained coordinates; ridge 0.01; bounded by calibration quantiles. No model-loss training.

generation.limits: 256 closed / 512 code / 1024 explanation; caps reported separately from repetition

protocol.scope: Small mechanism screen; does not establish 27B transfer or broad intelligence parity.
protocol.calibration_precision: CPU BF16 autocast; FP32 covariance accumulation; FP64 eigensolve. Projection construction and evaluation FP32.
protocol.sampled_states: Up to 32 evenly spaced states per complete conversation for RMS fitting and decoder probes; RMS fitting is token-weighted. PCA covariance uses every token.
protocol.pre_result_amendment: Enabled native CPU BF16 calibration before any activation packet or model result completed; all calibration arms use identical precision.
protocol.per_layer_transport: Skip path maps P_i.T @ P_next before the MLP residual addition; the MLP writer projects directly to P_next. Initial whole-block transport implementation was corrected before any candidate answer evaluation; its numerical audits are archived.
protocol.calibration_extension: Added a nested 256k-token arm using the exact original three-tokenizer sampler; declared before any compressed candidate answer evaluation. Extends beyond the original 64k recipe.
protocol.grading_clarification: After inspecting stock, before inspecting any compressed candidate answers: sorting content credit normalizes exact integer strings, with original strict type/format score retained. Uniform rule for every arm; no change to prompts or decoding.
protocol.supplemental_repetition: Uniform post-run repeated-line scan (>=8 identical nonempty lines), reusing summarize_scale_probe.repeated_line_run. Detects punctuation/code-fence loops missed by the separately retained word-gram metric.

additional_decoder_probe.purpose: Separate limited samples/fitting from absence of useful nonlinear recovery; same held-out states, no language-model healing.

linear_decoder_followup.fit: Per-site standardized zero-intercept ridge 0.1 from all 262293 calibration tokens; same encoder, RMS scales and deployed parameter count
linear_decoder_followup.reason: Post-diagnostic follow-up after larger-sample linear reconstruction recovered more dropped energy; answer evaluation held out and unchanged.

protocol.program_requirement_review: Report automated execution-test passes separately from manually reviewed full requirements. In particular, linear scanning does not satisfy the explicit binary-search instruction. No prompts, generations or execution tests changed.

grading: Independent answer grading, sandboxed program tests, interval input-immutability check. programs_correct counts execution passes; programs_with_reviewed_requirements additionally checks explicit algorithm requirements by manual review. Sorting accepts unambiguous integer strings for ordering correctness and records strict type/format separately, uniformly for all arms. Supplemental repetition scan applies the established project rule of >=8 identical nonempty lines; original word-n-gram flags are also retained. Explanation correctness requires manual review.
